extras: Requires Bases to be enabled in Obsidian. Processes note bodies, PDF text, and annotations locally.
intentEvidence: The goal is to make a separate reference manager optional for Obsidian users.
motivation: The goal is to make a separate reference manager optional for Obsidian users.
problem: Researchers need a unified system to manage sources, connect ideas, and write without relying on separate reference managers.

relations.evidence: Install Obsidian Web Clipper in your browser and set it to save into your inbox folder.
Zotero has helped researchers collect, organize, and cite their work for years. Stacks shares that respect for careful research and takes an Obsidian-first approach:
Find PDF, only when you run it, asks Unpaywall (with your contact email) and the work's landing page for an open-access PDF.
CSL-JSON for Pandoc and Quarto, or BibLaTeX or BibTeX, for the whole library or a filtered project, written on demand or automatically whenever references change.

summary: Stacks is a research library that integrates source collection, metadata lookup, PDF management, and citation workflows directly into the Obsidian vault.
